# Amazon Leadership Principles

> All 16 principles with interview questions, sample answers, and how the Amazon loop works. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Guides

- [Common Mistakes in Amazon Behavioral Answers](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/guides/common-mistakes.md): Most weak answers fail for one of ten reasons.
- [How the Amazon Loop Works](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/guides/how-the-amazon-loop-works.md): The loop is Amazon's name for the final interview stage, in which a candidate meets several interviewers in one day or across a few days.
- [Amazon Leadership Principles: One-Page Cheat Sheet](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/guides/one-page-cheat-sheet.md): Use this page for a final review.
- [Leadership Principles by Role](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/guides/principles-by-role.md): Every Amazon candidate is interviewed against the same 16 principles, but the emphasis and the expected size of the evidence change with the role and the level.
- [Amazon Leadership Principles Question Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/guides/question-bank.md): This page lists 96 behavioral questions, six for each of the 16 principles.
- [The STAR Method](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/guides/star-method.md): STAR is a four-part structure for answering a behavioral question, which is a question about something the candidate actually did in the past.
- [Building a Story Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/guides/story-bank.md): A story bank is a prepared set of true stories from your own work, each one written in the STAR format and mapped to the principles it can support.

## Principles

- [Are Right, A Lot](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/are-right-a-lot.md): Are Right, A Lot means making sound decisions when the information is incomplete, and being able to explain the reasoning.
- [Bias for Action](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/bias-for-action.md): Bias for Action means moving quickly and accepting a calculated risk when a decision can be reversed.
- [Customer Obsession](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/customer-obsession.md): Customer Obsession means that work starts from the customer's problem and is judged by its effect on the customer.
- [Deliver Results](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/deliver-results.md): Deliver Results means finishing the work that matters, on time and at the required quality, despite obstacles.
- [Dive Deep](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/dive-deep.md): Dive Deep means staying connected to the details and checking them personally when a summary and the facts do not agree.
- [Earn Trust](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/earn-trust.md): Earn Trust means being honest, listening carefully, and admitting one's own mistakes even when that is uncomfortable.
- [Frugality](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/frugality.md): Frugality means achieving more with fewer resources.
- [Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/have-backbone-disagree-and-commit.md): Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit means challenging a decision respectfully when one disagrees with it, even when the other person is senior.
- [Hire and Develop the Best](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/hire-and-develop-the-best.md): Hire and Develop the Best means raising the level of the team with every hire and helping other people grow.
- [Insist on the Highest Standards](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/insist-on-the-highest-standards.md): Insist on the Highest Standards means holding work to a quality level that others may consider too demanding, and fixing defects at their source so that they do not pass to the next team.
- [Invent and Simplify](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/invent-and-simplify.md): Invent and Simplify means finding a better way to do something and removing complexity that no longer justifies its cost.
- [Learn and Be Curious](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/learn-and-be-curious.md): Learn and Be Curious means continuing to learn throughout a career and exploring ideas beyond the current assignment.
- [Ownership](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/ownership.md): Ownership means acting on a problem because it affects the product or the company, even when the problem belongs to nobody or to another team.
- [Strive to be Earth's Best Employer](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/strive-to-be-earths-best-employer.md): Strive to be Earth's Best Employer means making the working environment safer, more productive, and more inclusive, and caring about the growth of colleagues.
- [Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/success-and-scale-bring-broad-responsibility.md): Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility means considering the effect of one's work on people beyond the direct user, including communities, partners, and the environment.
- [Think Big](https://github.com/design-gurus/amazon-leadership-principles/blob/main/principles/think-big.md): Think Big means proposing a direction that is larger than the immediate request and explaining why the larger version is worth the effort.
